<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposed single rear
extension, by reason of its excessive cumulative depth and siting, would be detrimental to the
amenities of the neighbouring occupiers at No. 62 Kenilworth Avenue, contrary
to Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013)
and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document
Residential Design Guide (2010).<span style="font-size:12.0pt;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposal, by
reason of the site being located within an area of land liable to flooding and
the lack of a comprehensive Flood Risk Assessment, due to a lack of flood mitigation measures which take into account the compensatory flood
storage details, has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would
not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and
consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to the National Planning Policy
Framework (2024), Policies SI12 and SI13 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy
CS1.U of Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM 9 and DM 10 of the Harrow
Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).<span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed front porch, by reason of its excessive depth, would compromise the existing parking provision in the forecourt, and would&nbsp;be likely to result in overhanging on to the pavement, to the detriment of the safety of </span>pedestrians<span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"> and other highway users. The proposal is therefore contrary to<span style="line-height:normal">&nbsp;Policy DM42&nbsp;of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></span></p>
description: Single storey rear extension; front porch; external alterations
